pages.title: Hoofddorp
pages.extract: Hoofddorp is a city part of the Haarlemmermeer polder in North Holland, Netherlands. It had 77,000 inhabitants in 2020.

pages.title: Hyannis
pages.description: village in town of Barnstable, Barnstable County, Massachusetts, United States
pages.extract: Hyannis is a village of Barnstable in Massachusetts on Cape Cod. It is the major commercial center including several malls and the regional air, bus and ferry terminals. It is most famous, however, for being the hometown of the Kennedy family.

pages.title: Khyber Pass
pages.description: mountain pass connecting Afghanistan and Pakistan
pages.extract:
The Khyber Pass is the main route between Pakistan and Afghanistan. The pass is entirely within Pakistan. The nearest major cities on the route that goes over the pass are Jalalabad in Afghanistan and Peshawar in Pakistan, with Torkham as border crossing point.
The only alternate route is the Bolan Pass, further south near Quetta, which crosses the same mountain range.

pages.title: Midelt
pages.extract: Midelt is a city in Morocco, in the Middle-Atlas.

pages.title: Northern Armenia
pages.extract: Northern Armenia includes the 3 northernmost provinces of Armenia.  The western part of this region is arid, while the central and eastern parts are often lush and green, with much of Armenia's forests.  The Debed river canyon of Lori Province is particularly beautiful and rich in monuments, along with the rolling hills of the remote Shamshadin, centered around Berd, and Dilijan-Ijevan.

pages.title: Quartzsite
pages.description: town in La Paz County, Arizona, United States
pages.extract: Quartzsite is a former mining town in La Paz County, Arizona. In 2020, it hosted a permanent population of 2,400 people, but during the balmy winters from December to February the population explodes to well over 100,000 as RV campers descend in droves in recreational vehicles to camp on the BLM (Bureau of Land Management) Lands surrounding the town.  Quartzite is also well known for gem shows, which draw over a million visitors yearly.

pages.title: Suwa
pages.extract: Suwa (諏訪) is a city in Nagano prefecture.

pages.title: Xinlong
pages.extract: Xinlong (新龙; Xīnlóng) is the capital city of Nyarong. Altitude 3050m. Barshok in Tibetan.

pages.title: Yubeng
pages.extract: Yubeng (雨崩) is a village in Northwestern Yunnan. Yubeng Village is a base for hiking and climbing in the Meili Snow Mountain Range.

pages.title: Caminhos do Imigrante
pages.extract: Caminhos do Imigrante (Immigrant Pathways) are tourist routes in Espírito Santo, in Southeastern Brazil. They were established to boost tourism in several cities of historical importance that were built mostly Italian, German and Pomeranian immigrants.

pages.title: Chiniot
pages.extract: Chiniot is a big city in Punjab (Pakistan), Pakistan. Situated along the river Chenab, Chiniot is one of the most ancient cities of Pakistan and historically a prominent town on the trade route between the Khyber Pass and Delhi. For ages, the city has been famous for the fine woodworks that are produced here. According to legend, Chiniot craftsmen were employed during the creation of the Taj Mahal. Today, Chiniot woodworks are known around the world and the city has become a bustling district capital.

pages.title: Deeside
pages.description: predominantly industrial conurbation of towns and villages in Flintshire
pages.extract: Deeside (Welsh: Glannau Dyfrdwy) is in Flintshire.

pages.title: Guachochi
pages.description: municipal seat of Guachochi, State of Chihuahua, Mexico
pages.extract: Guachochi is a city of 15,000 people (2010) in the southwestern part of Chihuahua state. If you are interested in indigenous cultures, you'll want to visit Guachochi to experience and learn about the reclusive Tarahumara people. Guachochi is designated as one of Mexico's Pueblos Mágicos.

pages.title: Sydney/Brooklyn
pages.description: town in New South Wales, Australia
pages.extract: Brooklyn is a small fishing town perched on the banks of the Hawkesbury River, making it one of the most northerly areas of Sydney. As it's south of the Hawkesbury, it's still considered to be a part of Sydney and it and some nearby islands such as Dangar Island are a part of Hornsby Shire Council.

pages.title: Redfield (Arkansas)
pages.extract: Redfield is a small city in the Timberlands region of Southern Arkansas.

pages.title: Amberg
pages.extract: Amberg is in Upper Palatinate. Having been a rich city in the early modern era, Amberg has a well preserved city wall.

pages.title: Worcester (Western Cape)
pages.description: town in the Western Cape, South Africa
pages.extract: Worcester is a city in the Cape Winelands. It is the largest town in the Western Cape's interior region, it serves as the hub of the Western Cape's interior commercial, distribution and retail activity with a shopping mall, well-developed central business district and infrastructure.
